snippet.title: [Dragon Village 3] Release Date Revealed
snippet.description:
Tamers, the adventure begins soon!
The next chapter of Dragon Village is finally here.
Launching worldwide on May 27!!!

The world you’ve only glimpsed in teasers is almost ready to explore.
Get ready to become the hero of a brand-new adventure!
